flow_name: Manage - Organizational Details - Trade Licence Document

prerequisite_flows._why: This flow starts signed in. The compiler runs these sign-in steps first when a case does not sign in itself; the Test Data names match the Journey KB role profile (TESTDATA_DEFAULT_ORG_EMAIL, TESTDATA_OTP).

automation_boundary.automated_scope: Authenticated B2B Portal home -> Manage -> 'view & update details' -> Organizational Details -> open and close the Trade Licence document -> sign out through the profile menu.
automation_boundary.external_boundary: Netcracker (Trade Licence metadata) and EDMS (binary documents) are upstream systems reached only through the B2B Microservice. Assert what the portal renders; never call them directly.

canonical_steps.action: Sign in to the B2B Portal as an Organization Administrator
canonical_steps.expected_result: The authenticated B2B Portal home page is displayed
canonical_steps._see_also: flow_b2b_login_otp carries the authentication steps in full. Deliberately not spelled out in this action text: the step matcher scores canonical steps by word overlap, and an action mentioning RECEIVE OTP here swallowed the real OTP steps of any case that used this flow.

canonical_steps.action: Open the Manage section from the main navigation
canonical_steps.expected_result: The Manage section opens with the organization's management options listed

canonical_steps.action: Open Organizational Details via the 'view & update details' link
canonical_steps.expected_result: The Organizational Details page loads showing the company's registered information

canonical_steps.action: Open the Trade Licence document from the Organizational Details page
canonical_steps.expected_result: The Trade Licence document viewer opens and renders the licence (PDF, PNG or JPEG up to 5 MB)

canonical_steps.action: Verify the Trade Licence metadata shown alongside the document
canonical_steps.expected_result: Trade Licence number, company name, issue date, expiry date and issuing authority match the licence on record

canonical_steps.action: Close the Trade Licence document viewer
canonical_steps.expected_result: The viewer closes and the Organizational Details page is shown again with focus restored

canonical_steps.action: Open the company profile menu in the header
canonical_steps.expected_result: The profile menu expands and offers Sign Out

canonical_steps.action: Sign out of the B2B Portal
canonical_steps.expected_result: The session ends and the login page is displayed; a protected route cannot be reached without signing in again

unverified_from_brd._status: Described by BRD_B2B_Portal_Trade_License_Automation_v2 and NOT confirmed in the application. Kept out of canonical_steps on purpose: a step here would be grounded as fact and would fail at execution. Promote an entry only once someone has seen it work.
unverified_from_brd.trade_license_column: A 'Trade Licence' column in the Manage Users table, sortable, with a per-user link (TLXXXXXX) or a '-' placeholder for unlicensed users.
unverified_from_brd.details_modal: A modal opened from that link, showing a loading spinner, five metadata fields, and an embedded PDF or Base64 image preview.
unverified_from_brd.api_contract: GET /api/v1/b2b-admin/trade-license/{tradeLicenseNumber}/details, 30,000 ms timeout, headers Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and X-Organization-Id.
unverified_from_brd.error_states: Missing document, corrupt Base64 payload, 30-second downstream timeout.
unverified_from_brd.note: The verified journey reaches the same licence through Manage -> 'view & update details'. Generate cases for the modal route only when the requirement asks for it, and say in Preconditions that the route is unconfirmed.
